question: Does the unchanged pure-far public-DTD / pre-AEC mic-reference energy-ratio behavior replicate across every complete no-movement farend-singletalk pair in the pinned ICASSP2022 real test set, using the same read-only Activity probe and no threshold, tuning, or sample selection derived from results?

source.rating_formula: full common-length mic+lpb clip; pinned AECMOS only calls process_interspeech2021 when the path contains test_set_interspeech2021, so ICASSP2022 receives no scenario-specific trimming

selection.rule: all GUIDs at the exact source revision under datasets/test_set_icassp2022/farend-singletalk that have both GUID_farend-singletalk_lpb.wav and GUID_farend-singletalk_mic.wav; exclude every farend-singletalk-with-movement file; no result-dependent filtering

inventory_binding.method: enumerate the exact Git tree before LFS materialization; for every selected path bind the Git LFS pointer oid sha256 and size into a sealed runtime inventory artifact
inventory_binding.freeze_protocol: first PR run was used only to read source-derived inventory count/bytes/fingerprint; those metadata are now committed and must match exactly before any acoustic execution

ci_resource_guard.authority: execution-resource-only; never an acoustic, quality, DTD, or selection boundary

observation_method.metric_definitions: reuse the frozen pure-far coverage summarize_rows helper over the full common-length frame interval

outputs: sealed all-complete-pair ICASSP2022 no-movement LFS inventory and fingerprint
per-case public DTD fraction when the current synced reference itself exceeds the existing far threshold
per-case smoothed and instant mic/reference ratio summaries
raw independent-energy boolean mismatch counts and zero unexplained mismatch count
descriptive Spearman association between case public-DTD occupancy and far-frame smoothed/instant mic-reference ratio
prohibited_actions: interpret acoustic results from any head whose source-derived inventory count/bytes/fingerprint are not frozen into the manifest
subsample cases after observing audio or diagnostic results
replace the all-complete-pair rule with a hand-picked subset
derive or search a DTD threshold
derive or search a gain-normalization constant
change the current 1.5, 0.90, 0.72, 1e-7, or 3-frame Activity constants
change DSP source or public DTD semantics
change Activity or VAD thresholds or timers
turn cross-dataset differences into a pass/fail classifier or ranking rule
revive I009 echo-normalized or residual-echo rescue
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: With the exact ICASSP2022 inventory metadata now frozen before acoustic execution, the diagnostic may describe whether broad pure-far false-DTD and its association with pre-AEC mic/reference energy ratio replicate in this second pinned official real test set. It cannot define a universal threshold, prove a physical device/room cause, or authorize a source candidate.
next_decision: exact-head acoustic replication evidence review only
